title: Foresee: Making Procedural Futures Tangible through Generative Previews
title_zh: Foresee：通过生成式预览，让程序化未来变得具体可感

paragraphs.en: Procedural guidance can show users how to act without explaining what an action enables later. We present Foresee, an interface combining next-step guidance with consequence previews, method comparisons, and cross-step access. A hybrid pipeline combines structured rendering, image editing, and video generation. A literature-informed framework and six-participant formative study shaped its design. A 24-participant study compared AR guidance, AR with generated video, and Foresee across digital painting, gameplay, and cocktail making. Exploratory painting comparisons showed higher correct completion without a recorded error than AR and higher post-task quiz accuracy than generated-video guidance under task-wise correction. Interviews revealed that users could overlook valued explanations, match visible outcomes without understanding later possibilities, or wait for concrete demonstrations when symbolic cues were unclear. These findings inform generative previews that explain what actions enable or constrain while supporting ongoing execution.
paragraphs.zh: 程序化引导可以指导用户如何行动，而无需解释某项操作后续能带来什么效果。 我们提出了 Foresee——一种将下一步引导与后果预览、方法比较以及跨步骤访问相结合的用户界面。 一种混合流程结合了结构化渲染、图像编辑和视频生成。 一个基于文献的框架和一项包含六名参与者的形成性研究塑造了其设计。 一项包含24名参与者的研究，在数字绘画、游戏操作和鸡尾酒制作任务中比较了AR引导、结合生成视频的AR以及Foresee的效果。 探索性绘画任务的对比显示，在任务过程中进行修正时，正确完成率高于使用AR的情况且没有记录到错误，而任务结束后的测验准确率则高于使用生成视频引导的情况。 访谈发现，用户可能会忽视重要的解释，仅凭可见结果进行操作却未理解后续可能性，或在符号提示不明确时等待具体的演示。 这些发现为生成式预览系统提供了参考，使其既能解释操作所带来或限制的效果，又能支持任务的持续执行。

paragraphs.en: Procedural guidance helps people carry out unfamiliar tasks through instructions and demonstrations ( Grossman and Fitzmaurice, 2010 ) . Yet completing an instructed action does not necessarily explain why it matters or what it enables later ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . As an illustrative example, consider adding a sun to a digital landscape. A separate layer preserves independent movement; drawing on the background may look identical initially but later require erasing and redrawing other parts of the image. An instruction to create a layer leaves this value implicit. Connecting the action to its consequences could explain the dependency before users incur rework. Prior work offers complementary ways to make these relationships available. Feedforward interfaces expose possible effects before users commit to an action ( Muresan et al., 2023 ; Coppers et al., 2019 ) , and reflective AR prompts encourage users to consider action purposes and hypothetical alternatives ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Multimedia learning provides a rationale for pairing explanatory words with relevant pictures ( Mayer, 2003 ) , while procedural tutorials such as MixT combine browsable text and images with per-step video to convey dynamic interactions ( Chi et al., 2012 ) . Together, these approaches motivate guidance that explains an action, depicts its consequences, and supplies execution detail when needed.
paragraphs.zh: 程序化指导通过指令和演示帮助人们完成不熟悉的任务（Grossman 和 Fitzmaurice，2010）。 然而，完成一项受指令驱动的行动并不必然能解释其重要性或它后续可能带来的能力（Zhang 等，2025）。 作为一个说明性例子，可以考虑在数字景观中添加一个太阳。 一个独立的图层可保持独立移动；最初绘制背景可能看起来完全相同，但之后可能需要擦除并重新绘制图像的其他部分。 创建图层的指令使这一值保持隐含状态。 将行动与其后果联系起来，可以在用户付出返工代价之前解释这种依赖关系。 先前的研究提供了补充性的方法，可用于呈现这些关系。 前馈接口在用户执行行动之前展示可能产生的效果（Muresan 等，2023；Coppers 等，2019），而反思性增强现实提示则鼓励用户思考行动的目的和假设的替代方案（Zhang 等，2025）。 多媒体学习为将解释性文字与相关图片结合提供了理论依据（Mayer，2003），而像 MixT 这样的程序化教程则将可浏览的文本和图片与每一步的视频相结合，以传达动态交互（Chi 等，2012）。 综合来看，这些方法共同推动了这样一种指导方式：在需要时解释行动、描绘其后果并提供执行细节。

paragraphs.en: Image and video generation offer a way to construct such representations from task specifications and available scene information ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ) . We define generative future previews as depictions of an upcoming action, possible subsequent state, or their relationship, given a starting state and candidate action or method. In the drawing example, an explanation and outcome image could show why moving a sun on a shared layer would disturb the background, while a video could demonstrate creating a separate layer. Generation produces task-relevant variants from shared procedural inputs and the current scene. We examine how users interpret and use these representations for prescribed actions and hypothetical alternatives. However, visibility alone does not make a future useful guidance. Users must interpret its connection to the current operation and decide whether further inspection is worthwhile. An image may clarify an expected appearance without explaining how the action changes later possibilities. A video may clarify motion or add redundant information and waiting. Alternative methods may enable meaningful comparison or leave users without a reason to prefer either route. Reflective AR prompts encourage reasoning about actions and outcomes, while Satori models user state and context to infer appropriate assistance ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ) . Foresee focuses on the representations through which prospective information becomes usable: pairing demonstrations of how to act with inspectable explanations of what those actions enable or constrain. The design challenge is to make these relationships interpretable and accessible within ongoing execution. This motivates our overarching question: How can generative future previews make action–consequence relationships understandable within ongoing procedural guidance? We address two research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 图像和视频生成提供了一种根据任务规范和可用场景信息构建此类表示的方法（Wan 等，2025；Kong 等，2024）。 我们将生成式未来预览定义为：在给定初始状态和候选动作或方法的情况下，对即将执行的动作、可能出现的后续状态或二者关系进行的描绘。 在绘图示例中，解释与结果图像可以展示为何移动共享图层上的太阳会干扰背景，而视频则能演示如何创建独立图层。 生成过程基于共享的流程输入和当前场景，产生与任务相关的变体。 我们研究了用户如何解读并使用这些表示来执行指定动作或考虑假设的替代方案。 然而，仅凭可见性本身并不会使未来预览成为有用的指导。 用户必须理解其与当前操作之间的联系，并判断是否值得进一步查看。 图像或许能阐明预期的外观，但未必解释该动作如何改变后续的可能性。 视频或许能说明运动过程，但也可能添加冗余信息或造成等待。 替代方法或许能实现有意义的比较，也可能让用户找不到偏好其中任何一条路径的理由。 反思性增强现实提示会鼓励用户对动作与结果进行推理，而 Satori 模型则会分析用户状态和上下文以推断适当的帮助方式（Zhang 等，2025；Li 等，2025b）。 Foresee 关注的是未来信息得以被使用的表示形式：将如何行动的具体演示，与可查阅的解释相结合，说明这些动作能实现什么或会限制什么。 设计上的挑战在于，如何在持续执行的过程中使这些关系变得易于解读和获取。 这引出了我们的核心问题：生成式未来预览如何能在持续的流程指导中，让动作与后果之间的关系变得清晰易懂？ 我们将探讨两个研究问题：

paragraphs.en: To address RQ1, we developed a literature-informed framework and explored six preview configurations in an iterative formative study with six participants. Feedback favored directly visible consequences over separate exploration controls, shaping Foresee’s combination of ordinary next-step guidance, consequence previews, method comparisons, and cross-step access (Figure 1 ). A hybrid pipeline instantiates these previews from reviewed procedural inputs and current scene images.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决研究问题 1，我们构建了一个基于文献的框架，并通过一项包含六名参与者的迭代形成性研究，探索了六种预览配置。 反馈表明，直接可见的后果比独立的探索控制更受青睐，这促使 Foresee 将常规下一步指导、后果预览、方法比较和跨步骤访问整合在一起（图 1）。 一种混合流程从已审查的流程输入和当前场景图像中生成这些预览。

paragraphs.en: To address RQ2, a 24-participant study compared the three guidance conditions within digital painting, gameplay, and cocktail making, measuring execution and post-task understanding. Interviews extended RQ1 through accounts of preview use and interpretation. Exploratory task-specific analyses identified benefits in Digital Painting. Foresee supported higher correct completion without a recorded error than AR alone ( p < .05 p<.05 ) and higher quiz accuracy than Video Gen ( p < .05 p<.05 ). Participant accounts suggest that concrete demonstrations can help users interpret abstract action cues, while consequence previews need clear connections to the current task.

paragraphs.en: A hybrid generation pipeline for physical and GUI-based guidance. Structured action–outcome specifications guide the generation of videos depicting prescribed actions and their intended outcomes. Combining UI rendering, image editing, and video generation supports both physical operations and GUI interactions.

paragraphs.en: Procedural guidance systems seek to connect instructions to their execution environment. Situated AR systems place text, labels, arrows, target poses, and animations on or near relevant objects. Studies in maintenance and assembly show that such in-situ presentation can improve localization, accuracy, completion time, or workload relative to detached or side-by-side documentation, although the benefit depends on registration quality and visualization design ( Henderson and Feiner, 2011b ; Henderson and Feiner, 2011a ; Blattgerste et al., 2018 ; Jasche et al., 2021 ) . Authoring and retargeting systems broaden this representational vocabulary: ProcessAR and TutorialLens capture demonstrations as stepwise 2D/3D guidance, PaperToPlace spatializes instruction documents, and media-retargeting pipelines recover registered object motion, target configurations, or tool trajectories from documentation and video ( Chidambaram et al., 2021 ; Kong et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Mohr et al., 2015 ; Mohr et al., 2017 ; Yamaguchi et al., 2020 ; Ihara et al., 2025 ) . These systems make procedures actionable in context but primarily guide users along authored routes.
paragraphs.zh: 程序化引导系统旨在将指令与其执行环境连接起来。 情境增强现实系统将文本、标签、箭头、目标姿态和动画放置在相关物体上或其附近。 维护和装配领域的研究表明，与脱离场景或并列放置的文档相比，这种现场呈现方式能够提升定位准确性、操作精度、完成时间或减轻工作负担，但其效果取决于注册质量和可视化设计（Henderson and Feiner, 2011b；Henderson and Feiner, 2011a；Blattgerste et al., 2018；Jasche et al., 2021）。 创作与重定向系统扩展了这种表现方式：ProcessAR 和 TutorialLens 将演示过程捕捉为分步的 2D/3D 引导，PaperToPlace 将指令文档空间化呈现，而媒体重定向流程则能从文档和视频中恢复已注册物体的运动、目标配置或工具轨迹（Chidambaram et al., 2021；Kong et al., 2021；Chen et al., 2023；Mohr et al., 2015；Mohr et al., 2017；Yamaguchi et al., 2020；Ihara et al., 2025）。 这些系统使流程能够在具体情境中付诸实践，但主要仍引导用户沿着预先设计的路径操作。

paragraphs.en: Guidance can also respond to task state and user progress. Context-aware AR systems track assembly status and update instructions during execution ( Khuong et al., 2014 ; Huang et al., 2021 ) , while demonstration-based systems link guidance to spatial, temporal, or progress triggers ( Kong et al., 2021 ; Chidambaram et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) . More recent AI assistants use scene observations and task progress to contextualize assistance: XaiR grounds responses in egocentric observations and spatial mapping, Guided Reality selects and places visual guidance, and Vid2Coach provides progress-aware instructions and feedback ( Srinidhi et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Huh et al., 2025 ) . Satori uses user intent and environmental context to guide interventions, while AdaptiveCoPilot adjusts modality and information load using behavioral and workload signals ( Li et al., 2025b ; Wen et al., 2025 ) . These approaches inform how guidance can be integrated into ongoing activity.
paragraphs.zh: 引导机制还可以根据任务状态和用户进度作出响应。 上下文感知的增强现实系统会跟踪装配状态并在执行过程中更新指令（Khuong 等人，2014；Huang 等人，2021），而基于演示的系统则会将引导与空间、时间或进度触发因素关联起来（Kong 等人，2021；Chidambaram 等人，2021；Liu 等人，2023）。 近期的人工智能助手利用场景观察和任务进展为辅助提供上下文：XaiR 基于自我中心的观察和空间映射生成响应，Guided Reality 会选择并放置视觉引导，而 Vid2Coach 则会提供与进度相关的指令和反馈（Srinidhi 等人，2024；Zhao 等人，2025；Huh 等人，2025）。 Satori 利用用户意图和环境上下文来指导干预措施，而 AdaptiveCoPilot 则通过行为和工作负荷信号调整呈现方式和信息负载（Li 等人，2025b；Wen 等人，2025）。 这些方法为如何将引导机制整合到持续进行的活动之中提供了参考。

paragraphs.en: Feedforward research more directly treats a not-yet-executed interaction as an interface object. In graphical interfaces, Fortunettes computes and visualizes a widget’s possible future availability or value before commitment ( Coppers et al., 2019 ) . In immersive environments, feedforward has been characterized through the triggering, previewing, and exiting of prospective action and outcome representations ( Muresan et al., 2023 ) . XR systems instantiate these representations with dynamic gesture paths, trajectories, target poses, ghosted hands or bodies, animation, and contextual video ( Fennedy et al., 2021 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Thoravi Kumaravel et al., 2019 ) . The principal unit of preview in this line of work is an interaction possibility and its immediate execution or outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 前馈研究更直接地将尚未执行的操作视为一个接口对象。 在图形界面中，Fortunettes 会在用户做出承诺之前计算并可视化某个组件未来可能的可用性或价值（Coppers 等，2019）。 在沉浸式环境中，前馈机制通过触发、预览和退出对潜在操作及结果的表示来体现（Muresan 等，2023）。 XR 系统使用动态手势路径、轨迹、目标姿态、虚影手或身体、动画以及情境视频来实现这些表示（Fennedy 等，2021；Yu 等，2024；Thoravi Kumaravel 等，2019）。 这一研究领域中预览的主要单位是某种操作可能性及其即时执行或结果。

paragraphs.en: Several systems move beyond a single immediate preview. MR-Driven Near-Future Realities explores the preview and reflection of possible everyday scenarios ( Mathis et al., 2024 ) . Building on these representations, we examine how consequence previews and action demonstrations fit into ongoing procedures.

paragraphs.en: Procedural understanding concerns how an action changes the task state and why that change matters for subsequent steps or goals. Research distinguishes performance during instruction from learning and transfer, motivating attention to what users understand as well as what they complete ( Soderstrom and Bjork, 2015 ; Eiriksdottir and Catrambone, 2011 ) . Kieras and Bovair showed that knowledge of component and control relationships helped users infer and simplify operating procedures ( Kieras and Bovair, 1984 ) . In the present work, consequence understanding concerns these action–state–goal relationships, including adverse consequences of deviations and differences between feasible methods. Feasible methods need not involve mistakes: they may share an immediate goal but differ in later implications. We assess post-task procedural understanding alongside execution.
paragraphs.zh: 程序性理解涉及一个动作如何改变任务状态，以及这种变化为何对后续步骤或目标具有重要意义。 研究区分了执行指令时的表现与学习和迁移能力，因此有必要关注用户不仅完成了什么，还理解了什么（Soderstrom and Bjork, 2015；Eiriksdottir and Catrambone, 2011）。 Kieras 和 Bovair 的研究表明，了解组件与控制之间的关系有助于用户推断并简化操作程序（Kieras and Bovair, 1984）。 在当前的研究中，后果理解涉及这些动作–状态–目标之间的关系，包括偏离操作可能带来的负面后果以及不同可行方法之间的差异。 可行的方法并不一定包含错误：它们可能共享一个即时目标，但在后续影响上存在差异。 我们在评估任务执行效果的同时，也评估任务完成后的程序性理解能力。

paragraphs.en: Interfaces can support these relationships through explanation, reflection, and comparison. Self-explanation research demonstrates benefits from prompting learners to integrate new information with existing knowledge ( Chi et al., 1994 ) . In AR-guided tasks, From Following to Understanding uses reflective prompts to connect actions with outcomes and consider hypothetical scenarios, reporting higher understanding quiz scores and more proactive information seeking ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Example-based learning provides a complementary rationale for presenting cases that users can interpret: Schwartz and Bransford found benefits for subsequent prediction from analyzing contrasting cases before an explanation ( Schwartz and Bransford, 1998 ) , while Adams et al. reported delayed learning benefits from identifying, explaining, and correcting erroneous solutions in mathematics tutoring ( Adams et al., 2014 ) . These findings motivate examining how brief previews support inspection and comparison of action–consequence–goal relationships during execution.
paragraphs.zh: 接口可以通过解释、反思和比较来支持这些关系。 自我解释研究表明，提示学习者将新信息与已有知识相整合会产生益处（Chi 等，1994）。 在 AR 引导的任务中，“从跟随到理解”通过反思性提示将行动与结果联系起来，并考虑假设情境，报告了更高的理解测验分数和更主动的信息寻求行为（Zhang 等，2025）。 基于示例的学习为呈现可供用户解读的案例提供了补充依据：Schwartz 和 Bransford 发现，在解释之前分析对比案例有助于提升后续预测能力（Schwartz 和 Bransford，1998），而 Adams 等人则报告，在数学辅导中识别、解释并纠正错误解决方案能够带来延迟学习的益处（Adams 等，2014）。 这些发现促使我们研究：简要预览如何在执行过程中支持对行动–结果–目标关系的检查与比较。

Foresee investigates how generated depictions and accompanying explanations make those relationships inspectable: a recognizable result can support an immediate check while leaving its implications for later actions unclear.

paragraphs.en: AI-based systems increasingly automate the construction of guidance artifacts. TutoAI extracts components for mixed-media tutorials, TAGGAR localizes reusable action visualizations, and CARING-AI generates context-aware avatar instructions ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Stover and Bowman, 2024 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) . ARify transforms narrated videos into editable AR tutorials, RePairAR derives reassembly guidance from disassembly recordings, and agentAR generates executable AR applications from natural-language requests ( Hu et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Beyond extracting, grounding, and constructing instructions, depicting actions and outcomes requires control over generated content.

paragraphs.en: Action-conditioned generation depicts how a current scene might change through an interaction. CosHand synthesizes a post-interaction image from a scene and a desired hand interaction, while InterDyn generates a temporally extended interaction from an initial frame and a motion control signal ( Sudhakar et al., 2024 ; Akkerman et al., 2025 ) . Applying these capabilities to procedural guidance requires consistent object identity, target location, action order, and resulting state. Evaluations such as T2VPhysBench, Physion-Eval, and MechVerse identify challenges in generating physically and mechanically consistent motion ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Jain et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于动作的条件生成描绘了当前场景通过一次交互可能发生的变化。 CosHand 根据场景和期望的手部交互合成交互后的图像，而 InterDyn 则根据初始帧和运动控制信号生成时间上延伸的交互（Sudhakar 等，2024；Akkerman 等，2025）。 要将这些能力应用于程序化引导，需要保持物体身份、目标位置、动作顺序和最终状态的一致性。 T2VPhysBench、Physion-Eval 和 MechVerse 等评估方法识别出了生成物理和机械上连贯的运动所面临的挑战（Guo 等，2025；Zhang 等，2026；Jain 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: HCI systems improve generative controllability by externalizing constraints. Map2Video grounds actor placement, trajectories, and camera framing in map and street-view geometry, while VideoCraft uses mixed-reality spatial layers to localize style and geometry transformations ( Jo et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ) . These creative-authoring techniques align generation with spatial intent. Foresee connects such control to instructional requirements: actions must also be correct, feasible, and appropriate to enact.
paragraphs.zh: HCI 系统通过将约束条件外部化来增强生成内容的可控性。 Map2Video 基于地图和街景几何结构来确定演员的位置、运动轨迹和镜头构图，而 VideoCraft 则利用混合现实空间层来定位风格和几何变换（Jo et al., 2025；Li et al., 2025a）。 这些创意创作技术使生成内容能够与空间意图保持一致。 Foresee 将此类控制与教学要求相连接：执行操作时，动作还必须正确、可行且恰当。

paragraphs.en: Explicit structure offers a complementary route to reliability. ElastoGen incorporates elastodynamic equations into learned 4D generation, while MotionCraft and Physical Simulator In-the-Loop Video Generation use simulated motion to guide generative video synthesis ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Savant Aira et al., 2024 ; Foo et al., 2026 ) . In interfaces, formal application or task structure can avoid unconstrained pixel prediction altogether: Fortunettes computes immediate GUI futures from event handlers, Demo2Tutorial reconstructs hierarchical task graphs from demonstrations, and agentAR produces executable AR application structures ( Coppers et al., 2019 ; Bai et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Structure makes transitions inspectable and controllable where objects, actions, and state changes can be represented explicitly. Pixel generation covers broader appearances and physical actions but permits more plausible-looking, procedurally invalid transitions.
paragraphs.zh: 显式结构为可靠性提供了另一种补充路径。 ElastoGen 将弹性动力学方程整合到所学习的四维生成中，而 MotionCraft 和 Physical Simulator In-the-Loop Video Generation 则利用模拟运动来指导生成性视频合成（Feng et al., 2026；Savant Aira et al., 2024；Foo et al., 2026）。 在接口中，正式的应用或任务结构可以完全避免不受约束的像素预测：Fortunettes 根据事件处理程序计算即时的 GUI 未来状态，Demo2Tutorial 从演示中重建分层任务图，而 agentAR 则生成可执行的 AR 应用结构（Coppers et al., 2019；Bai et al., 2026；Zhu et al., 2025）。 在结构化的系统中，对象、动作和状态变化可以被显式表示，从而使得转换过程具有可检查性和可控性。 像素生成能够覆盖更广泛的外观和物理动作，但也可能导致看似合理但程序上无效的转换。

sents.zh: 显式结构为可靠性提供了另一种补充路径。

paragraphs.en: These approaches motivate combining explicit task constraints with generated imagery and motion for procedural guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法促使我们将显式的任务约束与生成的图像和动作相结合，以实现程序化引导。

paragraphs.en: To address RQ1 , we combined a literature-informed framework, six candidate configurations, and a pilot study to explore preview content, access, and representation during task execution. Section 3.4.2 summarizes the resulting design.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决研究问题 1，我们将一个基于文献的框架、六种候选配置以及一项试点研究相结合，以探索任务执行过程中的预览内容、访问权限和呈现方式。 第 3.4.2 节总结了由此产生的设计。

sents.en: To address RQ1 , we combined a literature-informed framework, six candidate configurations, and a pilot study to explore preview content, access, and representation during task execution.
sents.zh: 为了解决研究问题 1，我们将一个基于文献的框架、六种候选配置以及一项试点研究相结合，以探索任务执行过程中的预览内容、访问权限和呈现方式。

sents.en: Section 3.4.2 summarizes the resulting design.
sents.zh: 第 3.4.2 节总结了由此产生的设计。

paragraphs.en: We conducted a purposive literature search on procedural guidance, feedforward, adaptive assistance, and prospective visualization. An initial keyword search in the ACM Digital Library, Google Scholar, SpringerLink, and IEEE Xplore was narrowed to 11 core papers selected for their relevance to our design question. Starting from these papers, we combined further targeted searches with citation chasing ( Wohlin, 2014 ) , adding 34 papers in the second round and 26 in the third, for a corpus of 71 unique papers. Repeated retrieval of previously encountered papers motivated the pragmatic decision to stop after three rounds. The corpus informed the design vocabulary used to develop our prototypes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对程序性指导、前馈、自适应辅助和前瞻性可视化进行了目的性文献检索。 最初在 ACM Digital Library、Google Scholar、SpringerLink 和 IEEE Xplore 中进行的关键词检索范围被缩小到 11 篇核心论文，这些论文因其与我们设计问题的相关性而被选中。 以这些论文为起点，我们将进一步的定向检索与引文追踪（Wohlin, 2014）相结合，在第二轮中增加了 34 篇论文，第三轮中增加了 26 篇，最终形成了一个包含 71 篇独特论文的语料库。 反复检索到之前已出现的论文促使我们做出一个务实的决定：在三轮检索后停止。 该语料库为开发原型所使用的设计词汇提供了依据。

paragraphs.en: We included task-executor-facing representations of upcoming actions, target states, or conditional outcomes connected to a physical or digital task. These comprised runtime guidance and separately described learner-facing outputs of authoring or generation systems. We distinguished these outputs from author-only controls, current-state feedback, and backend prediction or generation. Adjacent work informed the design vocabulary, while learner-facing configurations supplied the interface examples. Recorded demonstrations were eligible when their content concerned the learner’s upcoming action.
paragraphs.zh: 我们纳入了面向任务执行者的、与物理或数字任务相关的即将执行的动作、目标状态或条件结果的表示形式。 这些表示形式包括运行时指导，以及独立描述的面向学习者的内容创作或生成系统的输出。 我们将这些输出与仅限作者使用的控制机制、当前状态反馈以及后端预测或生成功能区分开来。 相关研究为设计术语提供了参考，而面向学习者的配置则提供了接口示例。 只要记录演示的内容涉及学习者即将采取的行动，该演示即被视为有效。

paragraphs.en: One researcher coded interface implementations, representations, and interactions. Each round, they discussed a provisional dimension table with two group members uninvolved in prototype design or literature coding and synthesis, then used their feedback to clarify definitions and overlapping categories. Configurations specify user role, research stage, and interface condition, situating components within their source systems. Four dimensions organize this vocabulary: Future Semantics, Future Structure, Future Interaction, and Future Representation . Their fields describe, compare, and combine design properties.
paragraphs.zh: 一位研究人员对接口实现、表现形式和交互进行了编码。 每一轮中，他们都会与两位未参与原型设计或文献编码与综合的团队成员讨论一个临时的维度表，然后利用他们的反馈来明确定义和重叠的分类。 配置会指定用户角色、研究阶段和接口条件，从而将各个组件置于其源系统中。 四个维度组织了这个词汇体系：未来语义、未来结构、未来交互和未来表现形式。 这些领域用于描述、比较和组合设计属性。

paragraphs.en: Future Semantics (S) describes the assumed state and action, the depicted content, and its relation to a task goal. It distinguishes, for example, showing a target location from conveying why a deviation matters.
paragraphs.zh: 未来语义学（S）描述了假设的状态和行动、所描绘的内容，以及这些内容与任务目标之间的关系。 例如，它能区分展示一个目标位置与传达某种偏离为何重要之间的差异。

sents.en: Future Semantics (S) describes the assumed state and action, the depicted content, and its relation to a task goal.
sents.zh: 未来语义学（S）描述了假设的状态和行动、所描绘的内容，以及这些内容与任务目标之间的关系。

sents.en: It distinguishes, for example, showing a target location from conveying why a deviation matters.
sents.zh: 例如，它能区分展示一个目标位置与传达某种偏离为何重要之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: Future Structure (T) describes the inspectable unit, organization, horizon, and relations between futures. A sequence of planned steps differs from a comparison of methods toward a shared goal.
paragraphs.zh: 未来结构（T）描述了可检验的单元、组织、时间范围以及未来之间的相互关系。 一系列计划好的步骤不同于为实现共同目标而进行的方法比较。

sents.en: Future Structure (T) describes the inspectable unit, organization, horizon, and relations between futures.
sents.zh: 未来结构（T）描述了可检验的单元、组织、时间范围以及未来之间的相互关系。

sents.en: A sequence of planned steps differs from a comparison of methods toward a shared goal.

paragraphs.en: Future Interaction (I) describes how content is proposed, accessed, edited, and navigated, and whether a choice advances the guidance. It separates optional inspection from required branch selection and preview navigation from task progression.
paragraphs.zh: 未来交互（I）描述了内容如何被提出、访问、编辑和导航，以及某种选择是否推动了引导进程。 它将可选的查看与必需的分支选择区分开来，也将预览导航与任务推进区分开来。

sents.en: Future Interaction (I) describes how content is proposed, accessed, edited, and navigated, and whether a choice advances the guidance.
sents.zh: 未来交互（I）描述了内容如何被提出、访问、编辑和导航，以及某种选择是否推动了引导进程。

paragraphs.en: Future Representation (R) describes the medium and its spatial, visual, and temporal presentation. AR anchoring is independent of medium: an upcoming action can be conveyed through a spatial cue, an image, or a video. A consequence image makes a possible state inspectable, but understanding why it matters also depends on the task context communicated alongside it.
paragraphs.zh: 未来表示（R）描述了媒介及其空间、视觉和时间上的呈现方式。 AR 锚定与媒介无关：即将发生的动作可以通过空间提示、图像或视频来传达。 后果图像使可能的状态可以被检视，但要理解其重要性，还需要结合一同传达的任务上下文。

sents.zh: 未来表示（R）描述了媒介及其空间、视觉和时间上的呈现方式。

sents.en: AR anchoring is independent of medium: an upcoming action can be conveyed through a spatial cue, an image, or a video.
sents.zh: AR 锚定与媒介无关：即将发生的动作可以通过空间提示、图像或视频来传达。

sents.en: A consequence image makes a possible state inspectable, but understanding why it matters also depends on the task context communicated alongside it.
sents.zh: 后果图像使可能的状态可以被检视，但要理解其重要性，还需要结合一同传达的任务上下文。

paragraphs.en: These dimensions separate content from inspection: extending the horizon changes structure, whereas changing viewpoint changes representation.
paragraphs.zh: 这些维度将内容与检验区分开来：扩展视野会改变结构，而改变视角则会改变表现形式。

paragraphs.en: We selected six configurations through literature-informed developer judgment, considering relevance to procedural guidance and feasibility within the shared pipeline. The framework articulated their differences and informed this selection.
paragraphs.zh: 我们基于文献指导的开发者判断，从与流程指导的相关性以及共享管道内的可行性两方面考量，选择了六种配置。 该框架阐明了这些配置之间的差异，并为此次选择提供了依据。

paragraphs.en: The selected set addresses three distinctions relevant to RQ1: continuing along a prescribed procedure, inspecting a hypothetical deviation, and recovering from an actual departure; comparing proposed methods and adjusting the current action through predefined options; and inspecting the immediate step and a broader procedural future. We explored these complementary functions within one prototype, bounded by available state information, reviewed task specifications, supported actions, generation waits, and content review.
paragraphs.zh: 所选集合解决了与研究问题一相关的三个区别：沿预定流程继续执行、检查假设性偏离以及从实际偏离中恢复；比较所提议的方法并通过预定义选项调整当前操作；以及检查即时步骤和更广泛的未来流程。 我们在一个原型中探索了这些互补功能，其范围受可用状态信息、已审查的任务规范、支持的操作、生成等待时间和内容审核的限制。

paragraphs.en: The initial candidate set included: Next-Step Preview , Deviation–Consequence Preview , Alternative-Method Preview , Recovery Preview , Multi-Step Preview , and Action-Variation Preview . Figure 2 summarizes their relationships using the next prescribed action and its near-term result as a common descriptive reference. In the exploratory prototype, each configuration had an appropriate interaction: alternatives were compared, Multi-Step Preview expanded to show future guidance, and action variations were selected through predefined current-step controls. Section 3.4.2 summarizes the retained candidates and their final forms.
paragraphs.zh: 初始候选集包括：下一步预览、偏差–后果预览、替代方法预览、恢复预览、多步骤预览和行动变体预览。 图 2 以下一个预定行动及其近期结果作为共同的描述性参考，总结了它们之间的关系。 在探索性原型中，每种配置都具有适当的交互方式：对替代方案进行比较，通过多步骤预览展开以显示未来指导，并通过预定义的当前步骤控制来选择行动变体。 第 3.4.2 节总结了保留的候选项及其最终形式。

paragraphs.en: Next-Step Preview, Deviation–Consequence Preview, Alternative-Method Preview, and Recovery Preview primarily distinguish action conditions and goal relations; Multi-Step Preview changes organization and navigation, and Action-Variation Preview changes how users specify the current action. Their cross-dimensional organization supports combination: a map could organize alternative methods or wrong-case consequences, while an edited action could generate a valid variation or an undesirable result. Interaction and representation determine how users access and inspect each configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 下一步预览、偏差-后果预览、替代方法预览和恢复预览主要区分行动条件和目标关系；多步预览会改变组织结构和导航方式，而行动变体预览则会改变用户指定当前行动的方式。 它们的跨维度组织支持组合：一张地图可以组织替代方法或错误情况下的后果，而经过编辑的行动则可能生成有效的变体或不理想的结果。 交互和表现形式决定了用户如何访问和检查每种配置。

paragraphs.en: Deviation–Consequence Preview connects a relevant state, a specified hypothetical deviation, a possible consequence, and the task requirement that makes the consequence matter. For example, drawing a sun on the background layer becomes problematic when the task requires later moving it independently. A brief description of that condition and an outcome image can make the potential loss of editability or repair cost visible before the user acts. Alternative-Method Preview instead compares feasible routes to a shared goal. The initial prototype also included a candidate labeled Recovery Preview , accessed through What Can I Do Now , which supplied corrective guidance after an actual departure from the expected state. We initially explored this corrective function alongside prospective guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 偏差–后果预览将相关状态、指定的假设性偏差、可能的后果以及使该后果重要的任务要求连接起来。 例如，当任务后续要求独立移动背景图层上的太阳时，绘制太阳就会变得有问题。 对该条件的简要描述和结果图像可以在用户行动前，使其可能失去编辑能力或修复成本变得显而易见。 而替代方法预览则比较了实现共同目标的不同可行路径。 最初的原型还包括一个名为“恢复预览”的选项，可通过“我现在能做什么”访问，在用户实际偏离预期状态后提供纠正性指导。 我们最初在探索这种纠正功能的同时，也研究了前瞻性指导。

paragraphs.en: Action-Variation Preview generated consequence videos for predefined adjustments to the current action: brush color, size, and opacity in digital painting; the object to collect in gameplay; and ice or ingredient quantities in cocktail preparation. These numeric parameters and categorical targets varied the action while preserving the goal and starting state.
paragraphs.zh: 动作变体预览为当前动作的预设调整生成了结果视频：数字绘画中的画笔颜色、大小和不透明度；游戏中的收集对象；以及鸡尾酒制作中的冰块或配料用量。 这些数值参数和类别目标在保持目标和初始状态不变的同时，改变了具体动作。

sents.en: Action-Variation Preview generated consequence videos for predefined adjustments to the current action: brush color, size, and opacity in digital painting; the object to collect in gameplay; and ice or ingredient quantities in cocktail preparation.
sents.zh: 动作变体预览为当前动作的预设调整生成了结果视频：数字绘画中的画笔颜色、大小和不透明度；游戏中的收集对象；以及鸡尾酒制作中的冰块或配料用量。

paragraphs.en: The six candidates shared a workflow: establish inputs and task requirements, specify action conditions, generate or organize content, and present it. This pipeline accommodated parameter changes, ordering changes, and downstream effects. The task requirements determine whether a parameter change expresses a Wrong Case, a valid alternative, or a trade-off.
paragraphs.zh: 这六位候选者共享一个工作流程：确定输入和任务要求，明确行动条件，生成或组织内容，并进行呈现。 该流程能够适应参数变化、顺序变化以及下游影响。 任务要求决定了参数变化是表达一种错误情况、一种有效替代方案，还是一种权衡取舍。

sents.zh: 这六位候选者共享一个工作流程：确定输入和任务要求，明确行动条件，生成或组织内容，并进行呈现。

sents.zh: 任务要求决定了参数变化是表达一种错误情况、一种有效替代方案，还是一种权衡取舍。

paragraphs.en: Following From Following to Understanding ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , we phrased brief cues as questions to encourage curiosity and consideration of consequences.
paragraphs.zh: 继《从跟随到理解》（Zhang 等人，2025）的研究之后，我们将简短提示设计为问题形式，以激发好奇心并促使对后果的思考。

paragraphs.en: Generation cost shaped presentation. We kept required Next Step guidance focused on the current action, with ordinary action videos providing execution detail. Outcome images conveyed states or consequences, and further action videos supplied process information when needed. Invocation, generation, and playback were configured separately: a user request could trigger a clip that then played automatically. This organization aimed to limit additional information and waiting in the mandatory guidance path.
paragraphs.zh: 生成成本决定了呈现方式。 我们将必要的“下一步”指导聚焦于当前操作，而常规操作视频则提供执行细节。 结果图像传达状态或后果，而后续操作视频在需要时提供流程信息。 调用、生成和播放被分别配置：用户请求可以触发一个片段，然后该片段自动播放。 这种组织方式旨在限制强制性指导路径中的额外信息和等待时间。

sents.en: Generation cost shaped presentation.
sents.zh: 生成成本决定了呈现方式。

sents.en: We kept required Next Step guidance focused on the current action, with ordinary action videos providing execution detail.
sents.zh: 我们将必要的“下一步”指导聚焦于当前操作，而常规操作视频则提供执行细节。

paragraphs.en: We explored the six candidates with six participants using think-aloud tasks, questionnaires, and interviews. A prerecorded-video comparison condition helped participants reflect on the usefulness of generated guidance and additional previews. Iteration brought valued but rarely opened information into view and set aside burdensome controls; feedback informed the final selection.
paragraphs.zh: 我们让六名参与者通过出声思考任务、问卷和访谈，对六个候选方案进行了探索。 一个预录视频的对比环节帮助参与者反思生成性指导以及额外预览内容的实用性。 迭代过程将宝贵但很少被使用的信息呈现出来，同时摒弃了繁重的控制设置；反馈则指导了最终的选择。

sents.en: We explored the six candidates with six participants using think-aloud tasks, questionnaires, and interviews.
sents.zh: 我们让六名参与者通过出声思考任务、问卷和访谈，对六个候选方案进行了探索。

sents.en: A prerecorded-video comparison condition helped participants reflect on the usefulness of generated guidance and additional previews.
sents.zh: 一个预录视频的对比环节帮助参与者反思生成性指导以及额外预览内容的实用性。

paragraphs.en: We revised the prototype after each participant. V1, V2, and V3 denote major milestones used by P1–P2, P3–P4, and P5–P6, respectively, with smaller changes within each pair (Figure 3 ). Later revisions introduced Qwen Image generation for outcome previews.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在每位参与者之后对原型进行了修订。 V1、V2 和 V3 分别表示 P1–P2、P3–P4 和 P5–P6 使用的关键里程碑，每对内部的变化较小（图 3）。 后续修订中引入了 Qwen Image 生成功能，用于预览结果。

sents.zh: 我们在每位参与者之后对原型进行了修订。

paragraphs.en: We recruited six participants from a local university (P1–P6; four male, two female; age: M = 22 M=22 , S ​ D = 4.04 SD=4.04 years). P1 reported familiarity with gameplay and P5 with cocktail preparation; the others reported no prior experience with the study tasks. One participant had previously used a Quest 3.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从一所本地大学招募了六名参与者（P1–P6；四男两女；年龄：M = 22 M=22，S ​ D = 4.04 SD=4.04岁）。 P1表示熟悉游戏玩法，P5表示熟悉鸡尾酒调制；其他人则表示没有研究任务的相关经验。 一名参与者之前使用过Quest 3。

sents.en: P1 reported familiarity with gameplay and P5 with cocktail preparation; the others reported no prior experience with the study tasks.
sents.zh: P1表示熟悉游戏玩法，P5表示熟悉鸡尾酒调制；其他人则表示没有研究任务的相关经验。

sents.en: One participant had previously used a Quest 3.
sents.zh: 一名参与者之前使用过Quest 3。

paragraphs.en: The study received university ethics approval, with identifying details omitted for anonymous review. Participants did not consume the alcoholic drinks they prepared, and headset discomfort prompted a pause and rest.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究获得了大学的伦理批准，其中涉及身份识别的细节已省略，以确保匿名评审。 参与者并未饮用他们自己准备的酒精饮料，且头戴设备带来的不适感促使他们暂停并休息。

paragraphs.en: The Quest 3 prototype provided step instructions, reference images, AR action cues, and video. The comparison condition used prerecorded videos; the generative condition used runtime-generated videos and the additional previews available in each revision. Both shared playback controls and automatic state-triggered progression in gameplay, with manual advancement in the other tasks.
paragraphs.zh: Quest 3 原型提供了分步说明、参考图像、AR 动作提示和视频。 对比条件使用了预录视频；生成条件则使用了运行时生成的视频以及每个修订版本中可用的额外预览内容。 两者都共享播放控制功能，并在游戏玩法中通过自动状态触发推进，而其他任务则需要手动推进。

sents.en: The Quest 3 prototype provided step instructions, reference images, AR action cues, and video.
sents.zh: Quest 3 原型提供了分步说明、参考图像、AR 动作提示和视频。

sents.en: The comparison condition used prerecorded videos; the generative condition used runtime-generated videos and the additional previews available in each revision.
sents.zh: 对比条件使用了预录视频；生成条件则使用了运行时生成的视频以及每个修订版本中可用的额外预览内容。

sents.en: Both shared playback controls and automatic state-triggered progression in gameplay, with manual advancement in the other tasks.
sents.zh: 两者都共享播放控制功能，并在游戏玩法中通过自动状态触发推进，而其他任务则需要手动推进。

paragraphs.en: From V3 onward, the generative condition included two fixed method decisions per task requiring a choice before guidance advanced. Other preview inspection was optional. Both conditions used backend GUI-target assistance when needed in gameplay and painting, without spoken or pointing assistance. Cocktail preparation used no such assistance.
paragraphs.zh: 从 V3 开始，生成条件中每个任务都包含两个固定的方法决策，在引导继续之前需要进行选择。 其他预览检查是可选的。 两种条件在游戏和绘画过程中需要时都会使用后端 GUI 目标辅助，但没有语音或指向辅助。 鸡尾酒制作不使用任何此类辅助。

sents.zh: 从 V3 开始，生成条件中每个任务都包含两个固定的方法决策，在引导继续之前需要进行选择。

sents.en: Other preview inspection was optional.
sents.zh: 其他预览检查是可选的。

sents.en: Both conditions used backend GUI-target assistance when needed in gameplay and painting, without spoken or pointing assistance.
sents.zh: 两种条件在游戏和绘画过程中需要时都会使用后端 GUI 目标辅助，但没有语音或指向辅助。

sents.en: Cocktail preparation used no such assistance.
sents.zh: 鸡尾酒制作不使用任何此类辅助。

paragraphs.en: Generated previews used the current scene image and a predefined step prompt that a language model could adapt. Failed attempts were retried.

paragraphs.en: Cocktail preparation involved measuring ingredients, following an addition sequence, and shaking. Gameplay combined physical inputs and GUI decisions in a survival game. paragraphs.en: All six valued recovery support, typically seeking it after mistakes, but incorrect guidance discouraged continued use. After encountering an initial failure in which the VLM decomposed recovery into inappropriate actions, P1-P3 stopped invoking the recovery control and preferred to explore using other guidance they considered reliable. As P1 put it, “Exploring on my own is faster and more accurate than waiting for guidance.” P1 also noted that feedback from the task software or environment already supported trial and error. These accounts emphasized the need for reliable correction that justified waiting.
paragraphs.zh: 所有六个智能体都重视恢复支持，通常在犯错后会寻求这种支持，但错误的指导使其不愿继续使用。 在首次遭遇失败后——当时 VLM 将恢复过程分解为不恰当的操作——P1-P3 停止调用恢复控制，转而更愿意尝试其他他们认为可靠的指导方法。 正如 P1 所说：“自己探索比等待指导更快、更准确。”P1 还指出，任务软件或环境提供的反馈本身已经支持了试错法。 这些描述强调了需要可靠的纠正机制，以证明等待是合理的。

paragraphs.en: Action-Variation Preview allowed users to adjust predefined parameters or targets of the current action and inspect the resulting video. P1-P3 found the feature interesting after viewing it, but did not spontaneously invoke it during task execution. P4 found its additional controls particularly burdensome: an already crowded interface led to yet more interaction after opening the panel. P2 anticipated using the feature only with sufficient prior knowledge and a strong desire to understand the task, while P1 felt that simple hints followed by self-directed exploration could be faster.
paragraphs.zh: 动作变体预览功能允许用户调整当前动作的预定义参数或目标，并查看生成的视频效果。 P1-P3 在观看该功能后认为其很有趣，但在执行任务时并未主动调用它。 P4 认为其额外的控制选项尤其繁琐：原本已经拥挤的界面在打开面板后又增加了更多交互操作。 P2 预计只有在具备足够背景知识并强烈希望理解任务时才会使用该功能，而 P1 则觉得简单的提示加上自主探索可能更快。

paragraphs.en: P3 expressed the distance between this exploratory activity and the immediate goal: “Before I finish the task, I do not want to explore questions beyond the next-step guidance.” Exploring changes to the current action could still feel removed from completing it, suggesting a role in later practice or deliberate exploration.
paragraphs.zh: P3 表达了这项探索性活动与直接目标之间的距离：“在完成任务之前，我不想探索超出下一步指导范围的问题。”探索当前行动的变更仍然可能感觉与完成任务相去甚远，这表明这种探索可能在后续练习或有意识的探索中发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: Participant accounts described AR cues and images as a lightweight starting point, with important task-specific exceptions. They turned to video when these representations left the next action unclear or when they were uncertain what their execution should produce. Participants valued prerecorded clips’ perceived accuracy, but clips covering more than the needed action required searching for the relevant moment, operation, or target, making details easier to miss. In time-sensitive gameplay, participants valued AR cues for reducing the effort of matching depicted objects and locations to the live scene. No participant paused ongoing gameplay to request or watch a video.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者将增强现实提示和图像描述为一种轻量级的起点，但任务特定的重要例外情况除外。 当这些表现方式无法明确下一步行动，或当他们不确定执行操作应产生何种结果时，他们会转而使用视频。 参与者重视预录视频的感知准确性，但若视频内容超出了所需动作的范围，就需要搜索相关时刻、操作或目标，这反而更容易忽略细节。 在时间敏感的游戏过程中，参与者认为增强现实提示有助于降低将画面中的物体和位置与实时场景进行匹配的难度。 没有一名参与者在游戏进行中暂停以请求或观看视频。

sents.en: Participant accounts described AR cues and images as a lightweight starting point, with important task-specific exceptions.
sents.zh: 参与者将增强现实提示和图像描述为一种轻量级的起点，但任务特定的重要例外情况除外。

sents.en: They turned to video when these representations left the next action unclear or when they were uncertain what their execution should produce.
sents.zh: 当这些表现方式无法明确下一步行动，或当他们不确定执行操作应产生何种结果时，他们会转而使用视频。

sents.en: Participants valued prerecorded clips’ perceived accuracy, but clips covering more than the needed action required searching for the relevant moment, operation, or target, making details easier to miss.
sents.zh: 参与者重视预录视频的感知准确性，但若视频内容超出了所需动作的范围，就需要搜索相关时刻、操作或目标，这反而更容易忽略细节。

sents.en: In time-sensitive gameplay, participants valued AR cues for reducing the effort of matching depicted objects and locations to the live scene.
sents.zh: 在时间敏感的游戏过程中，参与者认为增强现实提示有助于降低将画面中的物体和位置与实时场景进行匹配的难度。

sents.en: No participant paused ongoing gameplay to request or watch a video.
sents.zh: 没有一名参与者在游戏进行中暂停以请求或观看视频。

paragraphs.en: iPad painting provided an important contrast. Generated videos attracted the attention of P2, P3, P5, and P6, and all six described relying primarily on video because the AR stroke animations were difficult to interpret. This preference persisted even though AR and video depicted the same motion trajectory and AR guidance was available sooner. In this setting, seeing the movement within the video made the action easier to read. Occasional generation errors and fast playback frustrated P1 and P4 and interrupted their task execution. Outside painting, video was generally consulted when an operation was complex enough to warrant waiting.
paragraphs.zh: iPad绘画提供了一个重要的对比。 生成的视频吸引了P2、P3、P5和P6的注意，六人全部表示主要依赖视频，因为AR笔触动画难以理解。 尽管AR和视频展示了相同的运动轨迹，且AR引导更早可用，但这种偏好仍然存在。 在这种情境下，通过视频看到运动过程使动作更容易理解。 偶尔出现的生成错误和快速播放让P1和P4感到沮丧，并中断了他们的任务执行。 除了绘画之外，当某个操作足够复杂以至于需要等待时，通常会参考视频。

sents.en: This preference persisted even though AR and video depicted the same motion trajectory and AR guidance was available sooner.
sents.zh: 尽管AR和视频展示了相同的运动轨迹，且AR引导更早可用，但这种偏好仍然存在。

sents.en: In this setting, seeing the movement within the video made the action easier to read.
sents.zh: 在这种情境下，通过视频看到运动过程使动作更容易理解。

sents.zh: 除了绘画之外，当某个操作足够复杂以至于需要等待时，通常会参考视频。

paragraphs.en: The formative findings informed three design considerations.
paragraphs.zh: 初步研究结果指导了三项设计考量。

paragraphs.en: DP1. Make consequences directly accessible. Later participants consulted visible consequence information, while optional exploration saw little use. Consequence cues and images should therefore be available alongside the current instruction without requiring additional inspection controls.
paragraphs.zh: DP1。 使后果可以直接获取。 后续参与者查阅了可见的后果信息，而可选探索则很少被使用。 因此，后果提示和图像应与当前指令一同提供，而无需额外的检查控制。

sents.en: DP1.
sents.zh: DP1。

sents.en: Make consequences directly accessible.
sents.zh: 使后果可以直接获取。

sents.en: Later participants consulted visible consequence information, while optional exploration saw little use.
sents.zh: 后续参与者查阅了可见的后果信息，而可选探索则很少被使用。

sents.en: Consequence cues and images should therefore be available alongside the current instruction without requiring additional inspection controls.
sents.zh: 因此，后果提示和图像应与当前指令一同提供，而无需额外的检查控制。

paragraphs.en: DP2. Tie method comparison to actionable decisions. Later accounts valued choices connected to task continuation. Method comparison should therefore connect consequences to a decision the user can act on.
paragraphs.zh: DP2。 将方法比较与可执行的决定联系起来。 后续描述重视与任务延续相关的选择。 因此，方法比较应将后果与用户能够采取行动的决定联系起来。

sents.en: DP2.
sents.zh: DP2。

sents.en: Tie method comparison to actionable decisions.
sents.zh: 将方法比较与可执行的决定联系起来。

sents.en: Later accounts valued choices connected to task continuation.
sents.zh: 后续描述重视与任务延续相关的选择。

sents.en: Method comparison should therefore connect consequences to a decision the user can act on.
sents.zh: 因此，方法比较应将后果与用户能够采取行动的决定联系起来。

paragraphs.en: DP3. Match representation and timing to the action. Task-dependent media preferences and reported playback and generation problems highlighted the importance of action clarity and timely delivery (Section 3.3.5 ). Representation choice should follow the information needed at the current action while accounting for waiting and inspection costs.
paragraphs.zh: DP3。 使表示形式与时间同步于动作。 任务相关的媒体偏好以及报告的回放和生成问题，凸显了动作清晰性和及时传递的重要性（第 3.3.5 节）。 表示形式的选择应遵循当前动作所需的信息，同时考虑等待和检查的成本。

sents.en: DP3.
sents.zh: DP3。

sents.en: Match representation and timing to the action.
sents.zh: 使表示形式与时间同步于动作。

sents.en: Task-dependent media preferences and reported playback and generation problems highlighted the importance of action clarity and timely delivery (Section 3.3.5 ).
sents.zh: 任务相关的媒体偏好以及报告的回放和生成问题，凸显了动作清晰性和及时传递的重要性（第 3.3.5 节）。

sents.zh: 表示形式的选择应遵循当前动作所需的信息，同时考虑等待和检查的成本。

paragraphs.en: Beyond ordinary next-step guidance, Foresee retains Deviation–Consequence, Alternative-Method, and Multi-Step Preview (Figure 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 除了常规的下一步指导之外，Foresee 还保留了“偏差–后果”、“替代方法”和“多步预览”功能（图 5）。

paragraphs.en: Deviation–Consequence Preview is a visible panel pairing a brief “What if …?” cue with a wrong-outcome image, making a hypothetical deviation and its consequence inspectable before action.
paragraphs.zh: “偏差–后果预览”是一个可见的面板，它将一个简短的“如果……会怎样？”提示与一个错误结果图像相结合，使得在采取行动之前，可以检查假设性偏差及其后果。

paragraphs.en: Alternative-Method Preview compares methods at selected branches. It compares feasible methods through their outcomes, costs, affected steps, and action demonstrations. From V3 onward, each task has two fixed decision points; the user must select a method before guidance advances. Other preview inspection remains optional.
paragraphs.zh: 替代方法预览会对比所选分支处的各种方法。 它通过结果、成本、受影响的步骤以及操作演示来对比可行的方法。 从 V3 开始，每个任务都有两个固定的决策点；在引导继续推进之前，用户必须选择一种方法。 其他预览检查功能仍然可选。

sents.en: Alternative-Method Preview compares methods at selected branches.
sents.zh: 替代方法预览会对比所选分支处的各种方法。

sents.en: It compares feasible methods through their outcomes, costs, affected steps, and action demonstrations.
sents.zh: 它通过结果、成本、受影响的步骤以及操作演示来对比可行的方法。

sents.en: From V3 onward, each task has two fixed decision points; the user must select a method before guidance advances.
sents.zh: 从 V3 开始，每个任务都有两个固定的决策点；在引导继续推进之前，用户必须选择一种方法。

sents.en: Other preview inspection remains optional.
sents.zh: 其他预览检查功能仍然可选。

paragraphs.en: Multi-Step Preview is a compact, clickable step overview. It provides task-progress orientation and access to previously generated previews and previews of upcoming steps. Selecting a node changes the viewed content without changing the current execution step.
paragraphs.zh: 多步预览是一个紧凑且可点击的步骤概览。 它提供任务进度指引，并允许访问之前生成的预览以及后续步骤的预览。 选择某个节点会改变所查看的内容，但不会改变当前的执行步骤。

sents.en: Multi-Step Preview is a compact, clickable step overview.
sents.zh: 多步预览是一个紧凑且可点击的步骤概览。

sents.en: It provides task-progress orientation and access to previously generated previews and previews of upcoming steps.
sents.zh: 它提供任务进度指引，并允许访问之前生成的预览以及后续步骤的预览。

sents.en: Selecting a node changes the viewed content without changing the current execution step.
sents.zh: 选择某个节点会改变所查看的内容，但不会改变当前的执行步骤。

paragraphs.en: We retain Multi-Step Preview because its visible overview supports orientation without requiring exploration, while optional node access adds depth. Action-Variation requires additional manipulation and is set aside from the main workflow. Recovery addresses observed errors and falls outside our prospective-guidance scope. Here, minimal denotes a compact default presentation with fewer standalone exploration controls.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留“多步预览”功能，因为其可视化的概览无需探索即可帮助用户建立方向感，而可选的节点访问则为其增添了深度。 “动作变体”需要额外的操作，因此被置于主工作流程之外。 “恢复”功能用于处理已观察到的错误，但这超出了我们前瞻性引导的范围。 此处，“最小化”指一种紧凑的默认展示方式，其中独立的探索控制项更少。

sents.zh: “恢复”功能用于处理已观察到的错误，但这超出了我们前瞻性引导的范围。

sents.en: Here, minimal denotes a compact default presentation with fewer standalone exploration controls.
sents.zh: 此处，“最小化”指一种紧凑的默认展示方式，其中独立的探索控制项更少。

paragraphs.en: Foresee implements the interface developed through the formative study (Section 3.4.2 ) through reviewed plans and scene-conditioned generation. To support valid, interpretable guidance with acceptable waiting, it combines structured rendering for rule-defined content with diffusion for complex appearance and motion. Figure 6 illustrates the workflow through apple shading.
paragraphs.zh: Foresee 通过经过审查的方案和基于场景条件的生成，实现了通过初步研究（第 3.4.2 节）开发的接口。 为了在可接受的等待时间内支持有效且可解释的引导，它将结构化渲染用于规则定义的内容，并结合扩散模型处理复杂的外观和运动。 图 6 通过苹果着色展示了其工作流程。

sents.en: Foresee implements the interface developed through the formative study (Section 3.4.2 ) through reviewed plans and scene-conditioned generation.
sents.zh: Foresee 通过经过审查的方案和基于场景条件的生成，实现了通过初步研究（第 3.4.2 节）开发的接口。

sents.en: To support valid, interpretable guidance with acceptable waiting, it combines structured rendering for rule-defined content with diffusion for complex appearance and motion.
sents.zh: 为了在可接受的等待时间内支持有效且可解释的引导，它将结构化渲染用于规则定义的内容，并结合扩散模型处理复杂的外观和运动。

sents.en: Figure 6 illustrates the workflow through apple shading.
sents.zh: 图 6 通过苹果着色展示了其工作流程。

paragraphs.en: Foresee uses Qwen3.8 - 27B to organize task references into a predefined plan of stages, atomic actions, error-sensitive steps, and method choices, reviewed before deployment ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . During use, it combines the selected step with the current scene image to prepare action guidance and consequence previews.
paragraphs.zh: Foresee 使用 Qwen3.8 - 27B 将任务参考整理成一个预定义的阶段、原子操作、错误敏感步骤和方法选择的计划，并在部署前进行审查（Qwen Team, 2026）。 在使用过程中，它将选定的步骤与当前场景图像结合，以准备操作指导和结果预览。

sents.en: Foresee uses Qwen3.8 - 27B to organize task references into a predefined plan of stages, atomic actions, error-sensitive steps, and method choices, reviewed before deployment ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) .
sents.zh: Foresee 使用 Qwen3.8 - 27B 将任务参考整理成一个预定义的阶段、原子操作、错误敏感步骤和方法选择的计划，并在部署前进行审查（Qwen Team, 2026）。

sents.en: During use, it combines the selected step with the current scene image to prepare action guidance and consequence previews.
sents.zh: 在使用过程中，它将选定的步骤与当前场景图像结合，以准备操作指导和结果预览。

paragraphs.en: The hybrid pipeline prepares video inputs using structured rendering and compositing for rule-defined GUI content, or generated outcome images when needed. These frames guide action-video generation. The client displays available images and videos alongside AR cues, allowing users to inspect the guidance while continuing the task.
paragraphs.zh: 混合流程通过结构化渲染和合成来准备视频输入，用于规则定义的 GUI 内容，或在需要时生成结果图像。 这些帧为动作视频生成提供指导。 客户端会显示可用的图像和视频以及 AR 提示，让用户在继续执行任务的同时查看引导信息。

sents.en: The hybrid pipeline prepares video inputs using structured rendering and compositing for rule-defined GUI content, or generated outcome images when needed.
sents.zh: 混合流程通过结构化渲染和合成来准备视频输入，用于规则定义的 GUI 内容，或在需要时生成结果图像。

sents.en: These frames guide action-video generation.
sents.zh: 这些帧为动作视频生成提供指导。

sents.en: The client displays available images and videos alongside AR cues, allowing users to inspect the guidance while continuing the task.
sents.zh: 客户端会显示可用的图像和视频以及 AR 提示，让用户在继续执行任务的同时查看引导信息。

paragraphs.en: Each action specifies a precondition, intended state transition, observable outcome, and relationship to later steps. Separating actions from resulting states supports complementary representations: Deviation–Consequence Preview depicts a specified hypothetical outcome, while next-step and alternative-method videos demonstrate execution. Multi-Step Preview organizes access to guidance across the planned procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 每个动作都指定了一个前提条件、预期的状态转换、可观察的结果以及与后续步骤的关系。 将动作与其产生的结果状态分开，有助于实现互补的表示方式：“偏差–后果预览”展示一个指定的假设性结果，而“下一步”和“替代方法”视频则演示了具体执行过程。 “多步预览”整合了对整个计划流程中指导信息的访问。

sents.en: Each action specifies a precondition, intended state transition, observable outcome, and relationship to later steps.
sents.zh: 每个动作都指定了一个前提条件、预期的状态转换、可观察的结果以及与后续步骤的关系。

sents.en: Separating actions from resulting states supports complementary representations: Deviation–Consequence Preview depicts a specified hypothetical outcome, while next-step and alternative-method videos demonstrate execution.

sents.zh: “多步预览”整合了对整个计划流程中指导信息的访问。

paragraphs.en: Foresee’s hybrid pipeline combines structured rendering with image and video generation. For rule-defined GUI content, the planner produces a schema-validated rendering description that is compiled into rendering operations for text, icons, panels, and layout. Image editing constructs an action-relevant starting image or a hypothetical outcome; video generation supplies hand, tool, and other action motion. Foresee uses Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 with a four-step Lightning adapter for image editing and HunyuanVideo 1.5 for action demonstrations ( Qwen Team, 2025 ; LightX2V Team, 2025 ; Tencent Hunyuan Foundation Model Team, 2025 ) . This division controls interface structure while generating detail and motion beyond the rendering rules.
paragraphs.zh: Foresee 的混合流程将结构化渲染与图像和视频生成相结合。 对于规则定义的 GUI 内容，规划器会生成一个经过模式验证的渲染描述，并将其编译为文本、图标、面板和布局的渲染操作。 图像编辑会构建一个与动作相关的初始图像或假设结果；视频生成则提供手部、工具和其他动作的运动表现。 Foresee 使用 Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 配合四步 Lightning 适配器进行图像编辑，并使用 HunyuanVideo 1.5 进行动作演示（Qwen Team, 2025；LightX2V Team, 2025；Tencent Hunyuan Foundation Model Team, 2025）。 这种分工在控制界面结构的同时，能够生成超出渲染规则范围的细节和动态效果。

sents.en: Foresee’s hybrid pipeline combines structured rendering with image and video generation.
sents.zh: Foresee 的混合流程将结构化渲染与图像和视频生成相结合。

sents.en: For rule-defined GUI content, the planner produces a schema-validated rendering description that is compiled into rendering operations for text, icons, panels, and layout.
sents.zh: 对于规则定义的 GUI 内容，规划器会生成一个经过模式验证的渲染描述，并将其编译为文本、图标、面板和布局的渲染操作。

sents.zh: 图像编辑会构建一个与动作相关的初始图像或假设结果；视频生成则提供手部、工具和其他动作的运动表现。

sents.en: Foresee uses Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 with a four-step Lightning adapter for image editing and HunyuanVideo 1.5 for action demonstrations ( Qwen Team, 2025 ; LightX2V Team, 2025 ; Tencent Hunyuan Foundation Model Team, 2025 ) .
sents.zh: Foresee 使用 Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 配合四步 Lightning 适配器进行图像编辑，并使用 HunyuanVideo 1.5 进行动作演示（Qwen Team, 2025；LightX2V Team, 2025；Tencent Hunyuan Foundation Model Team, 2025）。

paragraphs.en: In the apple-shading example (Figure 6 ), the input pairs the canvas screenshot with an instruction to shade the apple’s lower-right side. The specification identifies the target region, motion, and intended shaded state. Alongside the instruction, spatial cues, an outcome image, and an action video show where to act, how, and with what result.
paragraphs.zh: 在苹果阴影示例（图 6）中，输入将画布截图与一条对苹果右下侧进行阴影处理的指令配对。 该规范明确了目标区域、运动方式以及预期的阴影状态。 除了指令之外，空间提示、结果图像和操作视频还展示了操作的位置、方式及预期结果。

sents.en: In the apple-shading example (Figure 6 ), the input pairs the canvas screenshot with an instruction to shade the apple’s lower-right side.
sents.zh: 在苹果阴影示例（图 6）中，输入将画布截图与一条对苹果右下侧进行阴影处理的指令配对。

sents.en: The specification identifies the target region, motion, and intended shaded state.
sents.zh: 该规范明确了目标区域、运动方式以及预期的阴影状态。

sents.en: Alongside the instruction, spatial cues, an outcome image, and an action video show where to act, how, and with what result.
sents.zh: 除了指令之外，空间提示、结果图像和操作视频还展示了操作的位置、方式及预期结果。

paragraphs.en: Generation timing depends on each step’s media requirements. When a video requires a generated end frame, image generation precedes video generation, increasing the wait. When code-rendered content and compositing suffice, this preparation is shorter. Available images can be displayed while video generation continues and remain accessible if it fails, allowing participants to retry.
paragraphs.zh: 生成时间取决于每一步的媒体需求。 当视频需要生成最终帧时，图像生成会先于视频生成，从而延长等待时间。 如果代码渲染的内容和合成已足够，则此准备过程会更短。 在视频生成继续的同时，可用图像可以显示出来，并且即使生成失败也能保持可访问，以便参与者重试。

sents.en: Generation timing depends on each step’s media requirements.

paragraphs.en: We analyzed historical service logs covering the user-study period and development tests. A single user request may trigger multiple server requests, so these service-level records provide a finer-grained view of runtime reliability across intermediate processing stages. Of 1,237 image/video requests, we excluded two final failures caused by upstream unavailability or connection refusal from both numerator and denominator. The retained 1,235 requests included 1,194 completions and 41 final failures (3.32%; Table 1 ). Failures comprised target/action recognition (23), invalid coordinates (8), screen registration (4), local generation timeouts (4), and HTTP 400 parameter errors (2). Completion denotes a finished service job. We also examined generated-video quality qualitatively through user-study observations and interviews (Section 5.6.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析了涵盖用户研究期间和开发测试的历史服务日志。 单个用户请求可能触发多个服务器请求，因此这些服务层记录为中间处理阶段中的运行时可靠性提供了更精细的视角。 在 1,237 个图像/视频请求中，我们从分子和分母中排除了两个因上游不可用或连接拒绝导致的最终失败。 保留的 1,235 个请求包括 1,194 次成功完成和 41 次最终失败（3.32%；表 1）。 失败类型包括目标/动作识别（23）、无效坐标（8）、屏幕注册（4）、本地生成超时（4）以及 HTTP 400 参数错误（2）。 “成功完成”指服务任务已顺利完成。 我们还通过用户研究观察和访谈对生成的视频质量进行了定性评估（第 5.6.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Step-level success required the instructed effect and target state, not matching the demonstrated movement or route. Alternative methods achieving the required effect counted as successful. In Digital Painting, this meant producing the required component and painting effect. In Gameplaying, each step had to achieve its intermediate goal, with overall completion defined by constructing the Science Machine. In Cocktail Making, actions had to satisfy the specified ingredient and preparation requirements. Omissions indicated unachieved step effects, not valid alternative routes. Scoring thus distinguished final-goal completion from intermediate requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 步骤层面的成功需要达到指定的效果和目标状态，而无需与演示的动作或路线一致。 通过其他方法实现所需效果的情况也视为成功。 在数字绘画中，这意味着生成所需的组件和绘画效果。 在游戏过程中，每个步骤都必须达成其中间目标，而整体完成则定义为建造科学机器。 在调制鸡尾酒时，操作必须满足指定的配料和制作要求。 遗漏表示步骤效果未达成，而非有效的替代路线。 因此，评分将最终目标的完成与中间要求区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Task goals, success criteria, and the underlying step-advancement mechanism were shared across conditions: task state triggered advancement in gameplay, while participants advanced manually in the other tasks. paragraphs.en: We recruited 24 participants (U1–U24; 13 male, 11 female; age: M = 26.7 M=26.7 , S ​ D = 6.5 SD=6.5 years), of whom 13 had prior VR/AR experience. paragraphs.en: We recorded whether each step was completed correctly, omitted, or performed incorrectly, including whether an error was subsequently corrected. Pre-action preview use was recorded separately from execution outcomes. Observations were checked with participants afterward, distinguishing corrected execution from correct execution without a recorded error. We report execution categories that distinguish corrected errors, unresolved errors, and correct execution without a recorded error.

paragraphs.en: For each task, we designed a quiz assessing factual recall, basic conceptual understanding, and knowledge transfer, following prior work ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Most quiz items addressed task knowledge that participants could also acquire through interaction with the task environment and exploration, rather than knowledge available exclusively in the additional preview panels. The Preview condition added step-specific explanations of selected action–consequence relationships, while participants across all conditions could also draw on ordinary guidance and task experience. Before task execution, participants identified items whose answers they already knew. We excluded these participant-specific items from both the numerator and denominator, calculating post-task accuracy over the remaining eligible items. Eligible item counts and respondent sample sizes are reported with the quiz results in Section 5.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 针对每项任务，我们设计了一项测验，用于评估事实回忆、基本概念理解以及知识迁移能力，这一做法遵循了先前的研究（Zhang 等人，2025）。 大多数测验题目涉及任务相关的知识，这些知识参与者也可以通过与任务环境互动和探索获得，而非仅存在于额外的预览面板中的知识。 “预览”条件为选定的行动–结果关系添加了步骤特定的解释，而所有条件下的参与者也可以利用常规的指导和任务经验。 在执行任务之前，参与者识别出那些他们已知答案的题目。 我们将这些参与者专属的题目从分子和分母中排除，仅对剩余符合条件的题目计算任务完成后的准确率。 符合条件的题目数量及受访者样本规模已随测验结果一同在第 5.5 节中报告。

paragraphs.en: We collected seven-point adaptations of the System Usability Scale (SUS) ( Brooke, 1996 ) and NASA Task Load Index (NASA-TLX) ( Hart and Staveland, 1988 ) . To compare representations of ordinary next-step guidance, participants ranked AR cues, ordinary reference images, and generated action video from 1 (most preferred) to 3 (least preferred) for each task. Here, images refer to the ordinary reference images shared across conditions, distinct from the additional consequence previews. A separate overall ranking ordered five components: Wrong Case, Multi-Step Preview, Alternative-Method Preview, Video, and AR, with lower ranks indicating stronger preference. Seven-point ratings assessed the choice interface’s alignment with personal priorities, perceived control, and interruption. Think-aloud accounts and semi-structured interviews complemented these measures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们收集了系统可用性量表（SUS）（Brooke，1996）和NASA任务负荷指数（NASA-TLX）（Hart和Staveland，1988）的七点评分版本。为了比较普通下一步指导的不同呈现方式，参与者针对每项任务，对AR提示、普通参考图像以及生成的操作视频进行了从1（最偏好）到3（最不偏好）的排序。此处所说的“图像”指的是各实验条件下通用的普通参考图像，与额外的后果预览不同。此外，还有一个独立的总体排名，用于对五个组件进行排序：错误情况、多步骤预览、替代方法预览、视频和AR，其中排名越低表示偏好越强。七点评分则用于评估选择界面与个人优先事项、感知控制以及中断之间的契合度。出声思考记录与半结构化访谈进一步补充了这些测量结果。

paragraphs.en: Higher SUS scores indicate greater usability, while higher NASA-TLX scores indicate greater workload.

paragraphs.en: The study comprised a task session (40–60 minutes) and a questionnaire, quiz, and interview session (approximately 30 minutes). After briefing and informed consent, participants had 10 minutes of system familiarization, then completed three assigned trials with five-minute breaks and think-aloud invitations. Questionnaires and task quizzes followed all trials, then a semi-structured interview covered overall experience, usefulness, difficulties, and generation delays. Participants did not consume the alcoholic drinks they prepared. Headset discomfort prompted a pause and rest.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究包括一个任务环节（40–60分钟）以及一个包含问卷、测验和访谈的环节（约30分钟）。 在说明情况和获得知情同意后，参与者有10分钟的时间熟悉系统，随后完成三个指定试验，期间每五分钟休息一次，并受邀进行出声思考。 所有试验结束后，紧接着进行了问卷和任务测验，随后通过半结构化访谈探讨了整体体验、实用性、困难之处以及生成延迟等问题。 参与者并未饮用他们自己准备的酒精饮料。 头戴设备带来的不适导致过程一度暂停休息。

paragraphs.en: Results are task-specific because action requirements, content, and inspection opportunities differ. Pooled execution and quiz comparisons detected no significant condition differences; the analyses below examine differences within each task. Within-task comparisons used participant-level summaries from independent groups. Execution comparisons used two-sided exact permutation tests, and quiz comparisons used Welch’s t t tests with an exact-permutation sensitivity analysis. For painting, we report mean differences ( Δ \Delta ) and pooled-SD Cohen's d d , with positive values favoring the first-named condition. The d d estimates are approximate because they use rounded summaries and eight participants per condition. SDs and Δ \Delta for percentage outcomes are expressed in percentage points. Task-specific analyses are exploratory, with Holm correction families and sensitivity results specified below.
paragraphs.zh: 结果因任务而异，因为行动要求、内容和检查机会各不相同。 合并执行和测验比较未检测到显著的条件差异；以下分析将考察每个任务内部的差异。 任务内比较使用了独立群体的参与者层面摘要数据。 执行比较使用了双侧精确排列检验，而测验比较则使用了韦尔奇 t 检验，并辅以精确排列敏感性分析。 对于绘画任务，我们报告了均值差异（Δ）和合并标准差的科恩 d 值，正值表示以第一个命名的条件更优。 d 值的估计是近似的，因为它们使用了四舍五入后的摘要数据以及每个条件八名参与者。 百分比结果的 SD 和 Δ 均以百分点表示。 任务特定的分析具有探索性，Holm 校正族和敏感性分析结果在下文说明。

paragraphs.en: Quiz accuracy was calculated per participant over eligible items, then averaged within each condition. Scoring covered 665 eligible item responses across 71 participant–task scores. In Preview/Video Gen/AR order, eligible items per participant were 10, 10, and 4–10 for Cocktail Making; 7–9, 6–9, and 9 for Digital Painting; and 9–10, 4–10, and 10 for Gameplaying. paragraphs.en: U7 and U14 described inspecting additional information when it matched their situation or uncertainty, while U8 associated inspection with failure or an unexpected result. Preventive information could thus become relevant through an already salient concern. Users could understand the warning’s hypothetical status yet see little reason to inspect it. The central issue was linking a possible consequence to an action they could check or change now.
paragraphs.zh: U7 和 U14 表示，当额外信息与他们的情况或不确定性相符时，他们会进行查看；而 U8 则将查看与失败或意外结果联系起来。 因此，预防性信息可能通过一个已经突出的担忧变得相关。 用户可能理解该警告的假设性质，但仍认为没有太多理由去查看它。 核心问题在于将一种可能的后果与他们现在可以检查或改变的行动联系起来。

paragraphs.en: U8 identified shaking motion and painting trajectories as information video could clarify. U14 turned to video when images and instructions were unclear but considered it unnecessary when AR was sufficiently precise. U22 likewise described proceeding without waiting when an image already conveyed how to act. Demand for detail depended on what remained unresolved at the step.
paragraphs.zh: U8 将摇晃动作和绘画轨迹视为视频可以澄清的信息。 当图像和说明不清晰时，U14 会转向视频，但当 AR 足够精确时，则认为视频没有必要。 同样地，当一张图像已经传达了如何行动时，U22 表示会直接行动而无需等待。 对细节的需求取决于该步骤中尚未解决的问题。

sents.zh: U8 将摇晃动作和绘画轨迹视为视频可以澄清的信息。

paragraphs.en: Familiarity and expected value shaped willingness to wait. U12 distinguished familiar tasks, where text sufficed, from unfamiliar tasks requiring further guidance. U18 considered waiting acceptable because generation seemed relatively fast and the information valuable. These contrasts connect selective inspection to familiarity and expected informational value.
paragraphs.zh: 熟悉度和预期价值影响了等待意愿。 U12 能够区分熟悉的任务（只需文本即可）和不熟悉的任务（需要进一步指导）。 U18 认为等待是可以接受的，因为生成过程似乎相对快速，且信息很有价值。 这些对比将选择性检查与熟悉度和预期信息价值联系起来。

sents.en: Familiarity and expected value shaped willingness to wait.
sents.zh: 熟悉度和预期价值影响了等待意愿。

sents.en: U12 distinguished familiar tasks, where text sufficed, from unfamiliar tasks requiring further guidance.
sents.zh: U12 能够区分熟悉的任务（只需文本即可）和不熟悉的任务（需要进一步指导）。

sents.zh: U18 认为等待是可以接受的，因为生成过程似乎相对快速，且信息很有价值。

sents.en: These contrasts connect selective inspection to familiarity and expected informational value.
sents.zh: 这些对比将选择性检查与熟悉度和预期信息价值联系起来。

paragraphs.en: U18 associated Multi-Step Preview and the directly displayed target preview with anticipating what would happen next. Other participants sought relationships rather than sequence alone: U14 wanted the logic connecting steps explained, and U23 wanted an account of intermediate painting operations, including layer settings and differences between methods.
paragraphs.zh: U18 将多步骤预览与直接显示的目标预览关联起来，以预测接下来会发生什么。 其他参与者则寻求步骤之间的关系，而不仅仅是顺序本身：U14 希望得到连接各步骤的逻辑解释，而 U23 则想了解中间绘画操作的详细说明，包括图层设置以及不同方法之间的差异。

sents.zh: U18 将多步骤预览与直接显示的目标预览关联起来，以预测接下来会发生什么。

sents.en: Other participants sought relationships rather than sequence alone: U14 wanted the logic connecting steps explained, and U23 wanted an account of intermediate painting operations, including layer settings and differences between methods.
sents.zh: 其他参与者则寻求步骤之间的关系，而不仅仅是顺序本身：U14 希望得到连接各步骤的逻辑解释，而 U23 则想了解中间绘画操作的详细说明，包括图层设置以及不同方法之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: Both methods at the decision points pursued the task goal. U22 considered whether an initially convenient action would incur later costs, while U9 preferred a route they could understand and anticipate. Conversely, U7 questioned the value of choosing between routes to the same goal, and U5 described arbitrary selection. Feasible alternatives did not always provide a meaningful basis for comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 决策点处的两种方法都追求了任务目标。 U22 会考虑最初看似便捷的行为是否会导致后续成本，而 U9 则倾向于选择自己能够理解并预测的路线。 相反，U7 质疑在通往同一目标的路线之间做出选择的意义，而 U5 则将其描述为一种随意的选择。 可行的替代方案并不总能提供有意义的比较基础。

sents.en: Both methods at the decision points pursued the task goal.
sents.zh: 决策点处的两种方法都追求了任务目标。

sents.zh: U22 会考虑最初看似便捷的行为是否会导致后续成本，而 U9 则倾向于选择自己能够理解并预测的路线。

sents.zh: 相反，U7 质疑在通往同一目标的路线之间做出选择的意义，而 U5 则将其描述为一种随意的选择。

sents.en: Feasible alternatives did not always provide a meaningful basis for comparison.
sents.zh: 可行的替代方案并不总能提供有意义的比较基础。

paragraphs.en: Even favorable accounts distinguished choice from understanding: U22 felt that choices clarified the goal while remaining unsure what distinguished the routes. U20 valued retaining choice because they did not fully trust the system. Thus, control could coexist with uncertainty about the alternatives or recommendation. The required choice made the basis for comparison especially important.
paragraphs.zh: 即便是有利的说明，也无法将选择与理解区分开来：U22认为选择能够阐明目标，但同时对哪些因素区分了不同路线仍不确定。 U20重视保留选择权，因为他们并不完全信任这个系统。 因此，控制权可以与对替代方案或建议的不确定性共存。 所需的选择使得比较的基础变得尤为重要。

sents.zh: 即便是有利的说明，也无法将选择与理解区分开来：U22认为选择能够阐明目标，但同时对哪些因素区分了不同路线仍不确定。

sents.en: U20 valued retaining choice because they did not fully trust the system.
sents.zh: U20重视保留选择权，因为他们并不完全信任这个系统。

sents.en: Thus, control could coexist with uncertainty about the alternatives or recommendation.
sents.zh: 因此，控制权可以与对替代方案或建议的不确定性共存。

sents.zh: 所需的选择使得比较的基础变得尤为重要。

paragraphs.en: All main-study interviewees reported that hallucinations in generated videos did not impede their understanding of the demonstrated actions. Several nevertheless noted inaccuracies in initial GUI target localization.
paragraphs.zh: 所有主研究的受访者都表示，生成视频中的幻觉并未妨碍他们理解所演示的动作。 不过，仍有几人指出初始 GUI 目标定位存在不准确之处。

sents.zh: 所有主研究的受访者都表示，生成视频中的幻觉并未妨碍他们理解所演示的动作。

paragraphs.en: U8 described using common sense to interpret an unnatural lid-opening depiction. U18 reported compensating for an offset position using an earlier correct example and AR cues. Requests for clearer brush identification (U18) and slider direction (U20) further highlighted details needed to act. These accounts concern identifying and interpreting the intended operation.
paragraphs.zh: U8 用常识来解释一种不自然的盖子开启描绘方式。 U18 报告称，他们借助一个早期的正确示例和 AR 提示来补偿偏移位置。 对更清晰的刷子识别（U18）和滑块方向（U20）的请求，进一步凸显了执行操作所需的细节。 这些描述涉及对预期操作的识别与解释。

sents.en: U8 described using common sense to interpret an unnatural lid-opening depiction.
sents.zh: U8 用常识来解释一种不自然的盖子开启描绘方式。

sents.en: U18 reported compensating for an offset position using an earlier correct example and AR cues.
sents.zh: U18 报告称，他们借助一个早期的正确示例和 AR 提示来补偿偏移位置。

sents.en: These accounts concern identifying and interpreting the intended operation.
sents.zh: 这些描述涉及对预期操作的识别与解释。

paragraphs.en: U13 described checking imagery against text, objects, and common sense, whereas U7 trusted the system by default. A plausible depiction could therefore receive different levels of scrutiny. These accounts emphasize identifiable targets, directions, and state changes, with complementary cues helping users interpret imperfect outputs.
paragraphs.zh: U13 描述了将图像与文本、物体和常识进行核对的过程，而 U7 则默认信任系统。 因此，一个合理的描述可能会受到不同层级的审查。 这些描述强调了可识别的目标、方向以及状态变化，同时补充提示帮助用户解读不完整的输出结果。

sents.en: U13 described checking imagery against text, objects, and common sense, whereas U7 trusted the system by default.
sents.zh: U13 描述了将图像与文本、物体和常识进行核对的过程，而 U7 则默认信任系统。

sents.en: A plausible depiction could therefore receive different levels of scrutiny.
sents.zh: 因此，一个合理的描述可能会受到不同层级的审查。

sents.en: These accounts emphasize identifiable targets, directions, and state changes, with complementary cues helping users interpret imperfect outputs.
sents.zh: 这些描述强调了可识别的目标、方向以及状态变化，同时补充提示帮助用户解读不完整的输出结果。

paragraphs.en: U5 paid little attention to intermediate painting operations when the visible result looked the same. U9 reported difficulty understanding independent editing in the Digital Painting task, and U20 consulted text and video while still finding consequences unclear. These accounts distinguish matching an appearance from understanding the later operations it permits. Related uncertainty extended beyond painting: U7 questioned why soda water was added later, while U22 discovered an earlier mistake through subsequent steps.
paragraphs.zh: 当可见结果看起来相同时，U5 对中间绘画步骤很少关注。 U9 表示在数字绘画任务中难以理解独立编辑，而 U20 在查阅文本和视频后仍觉得后续结果不明确。 这些描述区分了匹配外观与理解其允许后续操作之间的差异。 相关的不确定性也延伸到了绘画之外：U7 质疑为何要后来加入苏打水，而 U22 则通过后续步骤发现了一个早期的错误。

sents.en: U5 paid little attention to intermediate painting operations when the visible result looked the same.
sents.zh: 当可见结果看起来相同时，U5 对中间绘画步骤很少关注。

sents.en: Related uncertainty extended beyond painting: U7 questioned why soda water was added later, while U22 discovered an earlier mistake through subsequent steps.

paragraphs.en: In gameplay, many participants described understanding what each step accomplished as a major difficulty. They reported following bounding boxes and arrows while overlooking accompanying text, videos, and pictorial icons. Their accounts highlight a gap between locating the next action and understanding its purpose.
paragraphs.zh: 在游戏过程中，许多参与者表示，理解每一步操作的具体作用是一项主要困难。 他们反映，自己虽然遵循了边界框和箭头指示，却忽略了随附的文字、视频和图片图标。 他们的描述凸显出定位下一步操作与理解其目的之间的差距。

sents.en: In gameplay, many participants described understanding what each step accomplished as a major difficulty.
sents.zh: 在游戏过程中，许多参与者表示，理解每一步操作的具体作用是一项主要困难。

sents.en: They reported following bounding boxes and arrows while overlooking accompanying text, videos, and pictorial icons.
sents.zh: 他们反映，自己虽然遵循了边界框和箭头指示，却忽略了随附的文字、视频和图片图标。

paragraphs.en: U21 described a preview becoming meaningful through practical experience only after it had disappeared. This mismatch between presentation and interpretation motivates continued access as users gain experience, alongside separate assessment of execution and understanding.
paragraphs.zh: U21 描述说，预览只有在消失之后，通过实践经验才变得有意义。 这种呈现与解读之间的不匹配，促使用户随着经验积累而持续获取信息，同时还需要对执行和理解进行单独评估。

sents.en: U21 described a preview becoming meaningful through practical experience only after it had disappeared.
sents.zh: U21 描述说，预览只有在消失之后，通过实践经验才变得有意义。

paragraphs.en: For RQ2 , pooled comparisons detected no significant condition differences. Exploratory painting comparisons favored Foresee over AR for correct completion without a recorded error and over Video Gen for quiz accuracy under task-wise correction. For RQ1 , participants’ accounts highlight unresolved information needs, connections to current and later actions, and opportunities to inspect or revisit guidance. These accounts suggest conditions that may shape preview use, not causal explanations of the quantitative differences.
paragraphs.zh: 对于研究问题2，合并比较未检测到任何显著的条件差异。 探索性绘画比较显示，在无需记录错误的正确完成任务方面，“Foresee”优于“AR”，而在任务内修正的测验准确性方面，“Foresee”也优于“Video Gen”。 对于研究问题1，参与者的反馈凸显了尚未解决的信息需求、与当前及后续行动的关联，以及检查或重新查看指导的机会。 这些反馈表明，某些条件可能影响预览的使用方式，但并非定量差异的因果解释。

sents.en: For RQ2 , pooled comparisons detected no significant condition differences.
sents.zh: 对于研究问题2，合并比较未检测到任何显著的条件差异。

sents.en: Exploratory painting comparisons favored Foresee over AR for correct completion without a recorded error and over Video Gen for quiz accuracy under task-wise correction.

sents.zh: 对于研究问题1，参与者的反馈凸显了尚未解决的信息需求、与当前及后续行动的关联，以及检查或重新查看指导的机会。
